title: CLI Host Workflow Metadata v2.4.1
description: Canonical draft-07 schema for Host metadata. The root selects exactly one of two production branches: definitions.provisional_metadata_full_v1 (metadata_format_version=full-provisional-v1, metadata_finalized=false) and definitions.finalized_metadata_compact_v1 (metadata_format_version=compact-final-v1, metadata_finalized=true). definitions.continuation_state validates the separate continuation-state artifact; definitions.metadata_evidence_index validates the evidence index. definitions.legacy_full_metadata_v2_4_1 is read-only historical inspection and is deliberately excluded from the root.

continuation_state.title: CLI Host Workflow Continuation State v2.4.1
continuation_state.description: Finalized, machine-readable ending repository state for one Host pass.

legacy_full_metadata_v2_4_1.description: Read-only historical definition for unversioned v2.4.1 records. Excluded from the production root oneOf. Addressed explicitly for inspection only; it never validates a newly finalized record. This is the only definition permitted to retain exit_status_agreement.

exit_status_agreement.description: Diagnostic only: true when independently recorded capture-process and Code Agent exit statuses are numerically equal. Equality is not inferred and is not a workflow-finalization requirement.
